responsibility: Declares the LoongArch option-handling interface and exposes the resolved target configuration to the rest of the backend. It provides the global la_target object, switch-mask table, prototypes for the shared configuration and help-status routines, and a large set of target-condition macros such as TARGET_HARD_FLOAT, TARGET_TUNE_LA464, and TARGET_CMODEL_* that are used throughout loongarch.h, loongarch.cc, and the md files.
same_name_distinction: Exposes the resolved target state and option-handling interface for the loongarch-opts pair, including la_target, switch-mask declarations, resolver prototypes, and TARGET_* condition macros used by other backend files. Unlike loongarch-opts.cc, it is the shared declaration/macro header, not the resolver implementation.
